Hero.description: The Jannath Foundation UK is dedicated to supporting communities, empowering lives, and creating meaningful change through compassion, generosity, and action.
Hero.impactDescription: Together, we can make a difference.
Hero.imageAlt1: Support activities for children in the community

AboutFoundation.title: Building a Better Future,
AboutFoundation.description: We are committed to creating positive change through meaningful initiatives, community support, and opportunities that empower people to build a brighter future.
AboutFoundation.impactDescription: Together we can create opportunities and make a meaningful difference.
AboutFoundation.heading: We believe every small effort can create a big difference.
AboutFoundation.paragraphOne: Our foundation works to support people, communities, and initiatives that have the potential to create meaningful positive change. We focus on building trust, creating opportunities, and bringing people together around a common purpose.
AboutFoundation.paragraphTwo: Through collaboration and responsible action, we aim to create an environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and build a better future.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To create meaningful opportunities and support initiatives that bring positive and lasting change to communities.

community.title: Our Community
community.description: We believe real impact begins when people come together with a shared purpose, compassion, and commitment.

values.title: Our Values
values.description: Integrity, compassion, transparency, and responsibility guide everything we do for the people we serve.
